description: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University is a central university in Lucknow, established under Parliament Act No. 58 of 1994, with programmes across humanities, sciences, engineering, agriculture, biotechnology, business, law, education and environmental sciences.
agent_notes: All five supplied NIRF 2025 pages contain the institution row with Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh; the official site uses the spelling “Babasaheb” while the NIRF/context spelling is “Babasheb.”
The official site identifies BBAU as a central university, while INSTITUTION_CONTEXT labels it state_university; the institution name and Lucknow campus match.

The six-page Courses.aspx catalogue contains 107 programme cards, but the current 2026-27 PG prospectus and 2026 Ph.D. prospectus list additional or differently named programmes not present in that catalogue.
Because the official programme sources are incomplete and inconsistent, courses were not imported and manual review is required.
Normal TLS failed with the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error; public GETs then used curl --insecure only for the expected nirfindia.org and bbau.ac.in hosts.
